Introduction

NXD, also known as NeXt iDentity, is an upcoming three-member boy group under RBW. The group consists of Jaemin, Hyeonggeun, and Daehyun. Originally, former Boys Planet contestant Hiroto and trainee Yongjoon were set to debut with the group. However, on October 31, 2024, RBW announced that the two had left the group, and a new lineup would be formed.

Before debut, the members were unveiled during RBW's first family concert, "RBW 2023 Summer Fes ~Over The Rainbow~". The group released the pre-debut single "Jump" on April 18, 2024.
